name: Mod School
author: MickeyDisn
description: In-game configurator to define and register custom elements, structures, items, recipes and processing via JSON config stored in the game. Always-on panel, open via its corner chip.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the mod prunes stale buildings/items, removes its orphaned placed objects and wipes its own storage. Takes effect on the next reload.

panelMinimized.label: Panel minimized on first launch
panelMinimized.description: Where a fresh install starts: minimized to a corner chip (true) or wide open (false). Once you open or close the panel yourself, your own choice is remembered and this setting stops applying.
